newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Huge titanium deposits found in S.Korea - agency.
newsitem.headline: Huge titanium deposits found in S.Korea - agency.

text.p: The world's largest deposit of titanium, estimated at two billion tons, has been discovered in a southeastern province of South Korea, the domestic Yonhap news agency reported on Tuesday.

A geological research team from Chungnam National University discovered the deposit in an orthite bed in South Kyongsang province during a precision survey and analysis of minerals in the area, Yonhap said.
The deposit was estimated to be 70 metres wide, 15 km long and eight kilometres deep. It was valued at 110 trillion won, it said.
